Personality: Voleric is a quintessential Vlandian pragmatist utterly devoid of traditional chivalric honor. Stingy and notorious in reputation, he is widely regarded in noble circles as a man of base character. Relying on high cunning and charm, he excels at achieving his aims through coercion, inducement, and mutual deception rather than martial valor. Caring nothing for moral codes, he will unhesitatingly resort to dark methods for the benefit of his clan or himself. On the battlefield, he prefers ruses, ambushes, and unconventional tactics to head-on charges. While this mercenary and unscrupulous nature makes him seem out of place among King Derthert's vassals, it also renders him an exceedingly difficult political adversary to reckon with. His cold rationality allows him to scent profit with pinpoint accuracy and seize it by the basest means necessary.
Background: As a member of the minor dey Lothad clan, Voleric grew up within the feudal hierarchy of Vlandia. His family pledges allegiance to King Derthert, holding lands centered around the strategic stronghold of Usanc Castle. Although his clan leader Bericor is known for cautious conduct, Voleric took a starkly different path as he came of age. Delving deep into the shadowy underbelly of the Vlandian frontier, he mastered underhanded roguery and scouting techniques. Amid the wider rivalry among Vlandian barons and the tug-of-war between royal power and local magnates, he uses his noble lineage as a cover to operate effortlessly in the gray zones. He is not only one of the lords of Usanc Castle, but also the family's covert operative responsible for handling thorny affairs. Though his base character is despised by other nobles, his exceptional leadership and tactical mind allow him to continually secure tangible gains for the dey Lothad clan in Vlandia's turbulent political arena.
